subject.title: fix(hooks): bound hook workspace manifest and HOOK.md reads

question: When workspace hook package.json or HOOK.md exceeds the new 1 MiB limit, should discovery emit an actionable warning or intentionally remain a silent skip?
rationale: The mechanical helper reuse is clear, but current hook discovery silently ignores some invalid inputs while warning for other load failures, so source behavior alone does not establish the intended upgrade and recovery experience.

options.title: Warn and skip
options.body: Log the affected metadata path and size limit so operators can repair a hook that disappears after upgrade.

options.title: Silently skip
options.body: Treat oversized metadata like other ignored discovery inputs and omit it without a dedicated diagnostic.

recommendation.title: Warn and skip
recommendation.body: Log the affected metadata path and size limit so operators can repair a hook that disappears after upgrade.

likelyOwner.reason: The current workspace hook behavior and adjacent bounded-reader contract appear to originate from this contributor's merged work.
